implementation: Applications inject metadata-only package descriptors, complete-root loaders, explicit preloaded classic fallback and protected host CSS. Studio Vue/styles execute on selection.

The sole MusicSourceWorkbench retains one controller/audio above MusicWorkbenchThemeHost. Production feature adapters project existing source/library/player/download/settings/plugin instances and stable editing state.

Shared/SFC/selected-theme CSS is an inert string resource in the stable internal Shadow surface. A build-known collector uses identical scope IDs for templates and CSS. Protected slot CSS/detail-overlay targets stay within independent host surfaces.

Userscript preserves light document-start, first-expansion composition, GM namespaces and hide/show lifetime. Its artifact remains one file containing optional code. Tauri preserves embedded/capability-driven composition and native storage/authority; external links use composed paths.
Native-detail target isolation and Studio overlay pointer/position behavior are wired. Player retry reuses the same existing load path and retains upstream AppErrorState.
Old partial renderer composition is no longer reachable from the production Vue graph; physical legacy code/exports/selectors await T12 cleanup.

The production action now calls existing suspend/close-iterator and marks the listing for explicit restart; the test verifies cancellation, late-page rejection, request order [1,2,1] and maximum concurrency one. Root test/build reruns follow.
